def transform(grid):
    # The less frequent color maps to 0; the more frequent color maps to
    # the less frequent color. Verified against both demonstration pairs.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    rare, common = sorted(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[0 if v == rare else rare if v == common else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the background (most common color) to 0; mark foreground as the background color.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[0 if v == background else background for v in row] for row in grid]
